subject.title: fix: block workspace dotenv endpoint overrides [AI]

question: Should every environment-variable name ending in `_ENDPOINT` be treated as a network-routing control and therefore ignored from workspace `.env` files?
rationale: The implementation and proof are sound, but the generic suffix intentionally changes existing operator behavior and constrains future plugin or integration variable names; repository history does not by itself authorize that permanent compatibility boundary.

options.title: Accept the generic boundary
options.body: Treat all `_ENDPOINT` names as trusted-source-only, update the public documentation, and accept the operator relocation cost.

options.title: Block current keys only
options.body: Denylist the known Azure and OTLP endpoint variables while preserving unrelated third-party workspace `_ENDPOINT` names.

options.title: Add relocation diagnostics
options.body: Keep generic blocking but add visible warning or doctor guidance before existing workspace endpoint settings are silently ignored.

recommendation.title: Accept the generic boundary
recommendation.body: Treat all `_ENDPOINT` names as trusted-source-only, update the public documentation, and accept the operator relocation cost.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the workspace dotenv filter and authored the prior endpoint-routing hardening at this exact boundary.
